title: Gut Health App for Food, Stool & Symptom Tracking | Get Regular
description: Meet Get Regular, the iPhone app for logging meals, bowel movements, and digestive symptoms and reviewing possible patterns over time.
h1: Your gut is talking. Are you listening?
h2: You’ve been flushing your most powerful biomarker.
We turn gut feelings into gut data.
Built with a gastroenterologist, not just an algorithm.
Fresh reads for a happier gut.
h3: What is gut health? A practical guide to your daily signals
Bristol Stool Scale: how to describe and track stool form
How to keep a constipation diary that helps explain the problem
paragraphs: MEALS · STOOL · SYMPTOMS · DAILY INSIGHTS
Get Regular is a gut health app that analyzes your stool, meals and symptoms to give you personalized insights.
Read the population study
Stool form and changes in your routine can be useful observations about digestion. A photo is not a lab test, and an app insight is not a diagnosis.
Log meals with photos or text, record symptoms, and choose a Bristol stool type.
AI-assisted summaries help you review what you have logged, with limits and uncertainty.
Review your Gut, Nutrition, and Regular scores alongside the entries behind them.
Explore the app’s suggestions and experiments alongside what you have logged. Choose changes with appropriate professional guidance.
Keep logging and look back at what changes. Your own record helps you ask more specific questions over time.

Not to be dramatic, it’s only been 2 days — but I feel like it’s kind of life changing. Love having something to help keep me accountable to my own gut health and actually think about it on a daily basis. So cool and always such a fan of women’s health innovation.
As someone with celiac disease, it’s so refreshing to use an app that doesn’t reduce every bit of discomfort to your autoimmune condition. It feels really validating and thoughtful.
Just downloaded and have been using this app for a few days now. This is exactly what I’ve been looking for. From a girl with chronic constipation — thank you!!!

I just downloaded it and this is EXACTLY what I have been needing. I’ve been trying to track my gut health for a little bit but never had anything streamlined. I already started using it and it’s amazing! The way it gives you information immediately. This is mindblowing — they’ve created something spectacular.
User testimonials. Individual experiences — not typical results or medical advice.
Developed with a board-certified gastroenterologist, we bring the best of clinical expertise and holistic insight into one easy, daily app experience.

The app's internal analysis and outputs underwent extensive scrutiny and tweaking to ensure it correctly follows all current major gastroenterology guidelines as it relates to gut health — reliably demonstrating that the app provides users with a convenient, evidence-based interpretation of their personal digestive wellbeing.
Original advisor statement published by Get Regular. Advisory review is distinct from a clinical validation study or medical review of every article.
4 MINUTE READ
Understand what gut health means, which daily signals are useful to record, and how to bring digestive concerns to a clinician.
6 MINUTE READ
Learn the seven Bristol stool types, how to record a bowel movement, and why stool form alone cannot diagnose a digestive condition.
7 MINUTE READ
Record bowel movements, stool form, straining, and days without a bowel movement in a practical constipation diary for your next medical visit.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at hello@getregular.com
